description: First stable release of the Kerminal-only distribution — rebrand as TrellisKerminal, single npm package.
changelog: **Kerminal-only 0.7.0 stable.** Drops the other 22 upstream platforms, collapses configurators/templates to Kerminal only, renames the npm package to `trellis-kerminal`, and aligns docs/specs/CI with the single-repo layout.
notes: Install: `npm install -g trellis-kerminal`. No migrations required.
